attractions.name: Bishnoi Village Safari
attractions.description: Typically includes potters' houses, weaving units (dhurries), block printing demonstrations, a visit to a Bishnoi family home and learning about the 29 principles emphasising wildlife protection and tree conservation.

attractions.name: Bishnoi Village Safari, Guda Bishnoi
attractions.description: Village safari with mud huts, pottery and weaving demonstrations, and wildlife spotting (blackbucks, cranes, peacocks) around Guda Bishnoi Lake; optional camel-cart ride or tea with a local family

attractions.name: Guda Bishnoi Lake
attractions.description: Protected lake and water source for migratory birds and wildlife; blackbucks, chinkara, peacocks and migratory birds may be seen.
